name: Trend of new users and disabled users over time

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/windows-jsonformat  "\"Channel\":\"Security\"" ("\"EventID\":\"4720\"" or "\"EventID\":\"4725\"")  _sourceName=Security
| json "EventID", "Computer", "Message", "EventData.SubjectUserName", "EventData.SubjectDomainName", "EventData.TargetUserName", "EventData.TargetDomainName", "Channel" as event_id, host, msg_summary, src_user, src_domain, dest_user, dest_domain, channel nodrop
| parse regex field=msg_summary "(?<msg_summary>.*\.*)" nodrop
| where event_id in ("4720", "4725") 
| if (event_id = "4720", "New Users", "Disabled Users") as type 
| timeslice by 1d 
| count by _timeslice, type 
| sort by _timeslice asc 
| transpose row _timeslice column type
